component.name: RetroAchievementsSharp
component.summary: Hash ROMs and disc images for RetroAchievements

description.p: RetroAchievementsSharp is a native C# port of the RetroAchievements hashing engine (rcheevos/RAHasher). It computes the same hashes used by RetroAchievements to identify cartridge ROMs, disc images, archives, playlists, and encrypted 3DS content.
